title: Top-k words in a log
hints: Pattern: count then select. collections.Counter does the counting; the only work is choosing the top k with the right tie rule.
re.findall(r"\w+", text.lower()) gives the list of words with punctuation removed.
Counter.most_common(k) breaks ties by first appearance, not alphabetically, so sort or heap on the key (-count, word) instead.
heapq.nsmallest(k, counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])) returns exactly the required list of (word, count) tuples.
